events.summary: The timeline places the Dragon War story in the Time of Legends.
The timeline places the Battle of Kjeldor among the Coldsnap stories in the Flood Ages.
The timeline places the Fall of Sarpadia in the Flood Ages (c. 2935).
The timeline places the Assault on New Phyrexia in the Phyrexian Arc.
The timeline places the dawn of the Phyrexian Invasion in the Phyrexian Arc alongside the present portion of The Brothers' War.
The timeline places Gideon's sacrifice as the finale of the War of the Spark chronicles.
